_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Model upgrade banner: new chats show the upgrade before sending, and Switch updates the composer. The server offers an upgrade from the predictable model (display name "predictable") to a newer "Predictable Next" (ID predictable-next), and an init script sets localStorage "shelley_selected_model" to "predictable" before the page's own scripts on every load (already in place: steps must not set it). "The banner" is the element with data-testid "model-upgrade-banner". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. The banner's text should contain "Newer version of Predictable available". 3. The banner's text should contain "predictable → Predictable Next". 4. Click the element with data-testid "model-upgrade-action". 5. There must then be exactly 0 banners. 6. The text of ".status-field-model .model-picker" should contain "Predictable Next" (it need not be visible on this phone-sized screen; check its text). 7. eval localStorage.getItem("shelley_selected_model") must give exactly "predictable-next". 8. There must be exactly 0 elements with data-testid "model-upgrade-all-banner".
